definitions.core_principle: Before rejecting a match for any dosha (tara/kalatra, chevvai, sarpa, putra), check WHEN its dasa runs. A dosha whose dasa has already ended, or will only come very late in life, is dormant and must not block the match.
definitions.harm: Families often self-judge from a dosha label and reject good charts, causing years of delay (example native still unmarried at 35).
definitions.dasa_gate: Dosha is live only if its dasa/bhukti overlaps the marriage years (~22-45) or the married life window.

rules.name: Tara dosha (second-marriage indicator) for dual lagnas
rules.condition: lagna in dual_lagnas AND lord_7 own sign or exalted (lord_7 is also badhaka lord for dual lagnas)
rules.result: Two-marriage indicator - BUT only in lord_7's dasa.
rules.dormant_if: lord_7 dasa already finished before marriage, or never returns in life window

rules.name: Ketu with 7th lord
rules.result: Marital dispute can reach court - only in the relevant dasa.

rules.name: 2nd lord hidden
rules.result: Family life weak - only in lord_2's dasa; dormant if that dasa comes late (e.g. after 70).

rules.name: Exalted 7th lord in 11th
rules.result: 11th = second-spouse house; still harmless if that planet's dasa is over.

rules.name: Current dasa decides
rules.method: Evaluate the dasa running in the marriage window. Example: Saturn (lord_5 + lord_6 for Kanni) in kendra with lagna lord, in Sun's star (lord_12 with Venus) -> yoga dasa; marriage and family migration abroad indicated.

rules.name: Matching procedure
steps: List every dosha detected in both charts
For each, compute the dasa/bhukti that activates it and the age range
Mark dormant if outside the marriage / married-life window
Apply neutralisers (Jupiter aspect, retrograde, node links, neecha-bhanga) from other rulesets
Only live, un-neutralised doshas count against the match

engine_output_suggestion.match_report: For each dosha: name, carrier planet, activating dasa + ages, status live/dormant/neutralised. Never show a bare 'dosha present' label to families.

open_questions_for_implementation: Integrate with porutham (star-matching) module if horoscopegen has one
